result.instructions: Tools for Fitssey, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the class schedule and remaining capacity for this week."; "Compare the prices and session allowances of my passes."; "List low-stock studio products.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Fitssey data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fitssey_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fitssey_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fitssey_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. fitssey_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fitssey_list_classes
tools.title: List classes
tools.description: Read one page of the class catalog and categories. Excludes descriptions and private notes.

tools.name: fitssey_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: Read studio locations, business addresses and rooms. Excludes entrance instructions and phone details.

tools.name: fitssey_list_staff
tools.title: List staff
tools.description: Read one page of studio staff IDs and names; optionally filter by role. Excludes contact and profile details.

tools.name: fitssey_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: Read one page of products with SKU, stock and prices in the vendor’s smallest currency unit.

tools.name: fitssey_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Read one product’s stock, SKU and price. Excludes private notes.

tools.name: fitssey_list_pricing_options
tools.title: List pricing options
tools.description: Read pass catalog, session allowance and prices in the vendor’s smallest currency unit.

tools.name: fitssey_get_pricing_option
tools.title: Get pricing option
tools.description: Read one pass offering and its session, expiry and price settings. Excludes private notes.

tools.name: fitssey_list_contracts
tools.title: List contracts
tools.description: Read contract catalog IDs, names and online-sale flags. Excludes private notes and payment details.

tools.name: fitssey_get_contract
tools.title: Get contract
tools.description: Read one contract’s ID, name and online-sale flag; no payment or bank details.

tools.name: fitssey_get_schedule
tools.title: Get schedule
tools.description: Read scheduled classes and remaining capacities for a date range of at most 31 days. No bookings are changed.

tools.name: fitssey_list_courses
tools.title: List courses
tools.description: Read online-bookable courses and their scheduled sessions for a date range of at most 31 days.

tools.name: fitssey_get_schedule_event
tools.title: Get schedule event
tools.description: Read one scheduled event, capacities and assigned teachers. Excludes livestream URLs, passwords and private notes.

tools.name: fitssey_get_client_visits_report
tools.title: Get client visits report
tools.description: Read one page of class visits for at most 31 days, with client IDs, pass and payment status. Excludes names, emails and private notes. This page is not a complete attendance total.

tools.name: fitssey_get_sales_report
tools.title: Get sales report
tools.description: Read one page of sales for at most 31 days, preserving vendor monetary numbers. Excludes customer names, emails, addresses and invoice tax identifiers. This page is not total revenue.

tools.name: fitssey_get_active_passes_report
tools.title: Get active passes report
tools.description: Read one page of active client passes with client IDs and validity; cached by Fitssey for five minutes. Interpret remain with sessionType: limitedVisits counts visits, limitedTime counts minutes, and -1 means no session limit. Excludes names and emails. This page is not a full membership total.
